entries.description: MCP Server Card for the remote BCV Today MCP server at https://mcp.bcv.today/mcp (Streamable HTTP, stateless, no authentication). Tools: get_latest_rates, get_rate_by_date, get_history, convert and get_status, backed by the official Banco Central de Venezuela rates for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar.
representativeQueries: MCP server for the official Venezuelan exchange rate
convert dollars to bolivars at the BCV rate
¿cuál fue la tasa del dólar BCV el 2 de enero de 2026?
historial del euro BCV de los últimos 30 días

entries.description: OpenAPI 3.1 description of the free, public, read-only static JSON API with the official Banco Central de Venezuela exchange rates (USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar): latest rate, daily history, single-day snapshots and status. No authentication.
representativeQueries: official USD to VES exchange rate today

entries.description: Static JSON file with the BCV rates currently in effect for USD, EUR, CNY, TRY and RUB against the bolivar, with effective_date and updated_at. Changes at most once per business day.
representativeQueries: precio del dólar oficial en Venezuela hoy
current BCV dollar rate in bolivars
tasa BCV del día en bolívares

entries.description: Agent card describing the data-access capabilities of the BCV Today API (latest rates and history). Discovery metadata only: there is no A2A endpoint; the interface is the static JSON API described by the OpenAPI document.
representativeQueries: agent that returns the official Venezuelan exchange rate
agente para consultar la tasa del BCV

entries.description: Plain-text agent index for the site: API endpoints, data notes, Markdown versions of the pages and discovery documents.
representativeQueries: how do I use the BCV Today API
documentación de la API de tasas BCV

entries.description: RFC 9727 API catalog linkset pointing to the OpenAPI description, API documentation, status endpoint and agent metadata.
representativeQueries: list the APIs published by bcv.today

entries.description: Agent Skills index listing the bcv-rates skill, which explains how to fetch official BCV exchange rates and history from the static JSON API.
representativeQueries: skill to fetch BCV exchange rates
consultar el historial de la tasa BCV por fecha
